rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering of this F5 follow-up no-improvement review; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
No-improvement review needs a documented current baseline encounter/window with completed PANSS baseline and follow-up and adequate clozapine-trial context; no percent-change cutoff is set here.
Improvement documented with current baseline and completed PANSS is not_applicable and claims no posterior; it is never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.
Missing PANSS follow-up is never treated as no improvement; outdated baselines and not-assessed severity pause for clarification.
Urgent banner comes from saved structured urgent inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage.
No dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are collected or accepted.
urgent_banner: Urgent safety banner from saved structured urgent inputs, shown independently of estimation latency and not a computed risk percentage: arrange immediate clinician assessment per local protocol when Present in this follow-up context.
